title: Levushei Tzedakah
versionTitle: Akiva Publishing interlinear edition with source notes and parallels (November 2026)
editionNote: Levushei Tzedakah (Rabbi Tzadok HaKohen of Lublin) on Choshen Mishpat, with his novellae, Ein Yaakov on Shabbos and a responsum: phrase-by-phrase vocalized Hebrew with English, 186 numbered source and parallel notes with Sefaria links.
